people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
translations.bsb: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you desire, I will do for you.”
translations.kjv: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
translations.asv: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
